cross_task_findings.issue: i18n preview-key shape mismatch between producer (Task 4) and consumer (Task 6). Task 4 — the authoritative canonical contract — defines `funnels.editor.preview` as a FLAT string (toggle label "Прев'ю") plus two separate FLAT siblings `funnels.editor.previewPlaceholder` and `funnels.editor.previewSampleData`. Task 6 instead references a NESTED namespace `funnels.editor.preview.*` for the non-message placeholder (line 33: «плейсхолдер з i18n-ключа (Task 4 додає `funnels.editor.preview.*` / плейсхолдер)»; line 103: «i18n-ключі `funnels.editor.preview.*`»). A flat string and a nested object cannot coexist at the same JSON key `funnels.editor.preview` — the consumer's referenced shape contradicts the producer's canonical shape. Task 6 must consume the flat keys `funnels.editor.previewPlaceholder` / `funnels.editor.previewSampleData` exactly as Task 4 emits them, not a `preview.*` sub-object.
cross_task_findings.fix: Edit Task 6 (lines 33 and 103) to reference the canonical FLAT keys `funnels.editor.previewPlaceholder` (non-message placeholder) and `funnels.editor.previewSampleData` (sample-data indicator), removing every `funnels.editor.preview.*` nested reference. Keep `funnels.editor.preview` as the flat toggle-label only.
